title: The Giant Fish That Rises From The Deep | Blue Planet III | 4k | BBC Earth

segments.description: Medium close-up shot of a giant mola mola swimming near the ocean surface [[00:01](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_9bmrDZRsmo&t=1)].
Medium action shot of the mola mola rising from the deep blue waters to feed on jellyfish near the surface [[00:15](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_9bmrDZRsmo&t=15)].
Close-up action shot of the giant sunfish devouring multiple jellyfish in open water [[00:32](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_9bmrDZRsmo&t=32)].
Wide establishing shot of a floating kelp forest oasis in the middle of the deep blue ocean [[00:49](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_9bmrDZRsmo&t=49)].
Medium close-up shot of half-moon fish gathering around the mola mola to feed on its parasites [[01:15](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_9bmrDZRsmo&t=75)].
Close-up action shot of the mola mola being gently cleaned and pampered by smaller reef fish [[01:57](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_9bmrDZRsmo&t=117)].
Wide aerial shot of the giant sunfish basking in the warm surface sunlight before returning to the cold depths [[02:27](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_9bmrDZRsmo&t=147)].
